description: SPEC §6.4: approval title and description. Lines are joined with '\n'. Argument lines: command arguments first (whole command, cut to 240), then the other arguments sorted by name, at most 5 argument lines in total; values are strings as given, other JSON values compact JSON; newlines become '⏎'; a value longer than its limit (80, or 240 for a command) becomes its first limit-1 characters + '…'; an argument whose name contains (case-insensitive) password, secret, token, key, auth, cookie or credential shows '[hidden]'. The description is cut the same way to 480. Title: 'Allow <tool>?' or 'Allow <mcpTool> on <server>?', cut to 80. 'why' is the reason text of vectors/decide.json.
